listing.name: Ace Combat 04: Shattered Skies (Ace Combat 04: Shattered Skies - PC Port)
listing.summary: A work-in-progress Ace Combat 04 beta, rather than a complete remaster or confirmed campaign. The Windows installer and separate source route translate the PS2 main CPU and build locally from your own USA SLUS-20152 executable and disc data; hardware/runtime services remain separate responsibilities. Exact host CPU architecture follows the selected setup guide, while accepted revision/hashes and BIOS/firmware needs are unconfirmed here. You and the project manage installation and replacement. Portcove has not qualified the installer or confirmed setup or gameplay.
